description: This file defines the LDAPSyncStatus entity class used in the OrangeHRM system. It models the status of LDAP synchronization, including timestamps for when synchronization starts and ends, the user who performed the sync, and the sync status code. The class uses Doctrine ORM annotations for database mapping and includes constants for different sync statuses.

classes.name: LDAPSyncStatus
classes.description: Entity representing LDAP synchronization status, including timestamps, user who initiated the sync, and sync state constants.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the LDAP sync status record.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the LDAP sync status record.

methods.name: getSyncStartedAt
methods.description: Returns the DateTime when the sync started.

methods.name: setSyncStartedAt
methods.description: Sets the DateTime when the sync started.

methods.name: getSyncFinishedAt
methods.description: Returns the DateTime when the sync finished.

methods.name: setSyncFinishedAt
methods.description: Sets the DateTime when the sync finished.

methods.name: getSyncedBy
methods.description: Returns the User who performed the sync.

methods.name: setSyncedBy
methods.description: Sets the User who performed the sync.

methods.name: getSyncStatus
methods.description: Returns the current sync status code.
